answer: To curb Sybil attacks, an agent economy can bind node identities to micro-barometric fluctuations. An agent authenticates by matching ambient pressure shifts against reference beacons at a timber yard, an arid mesa, and a harbor wharf. An adversary cannot simulate these fluid dynamics, forcing them to deploy dedicated physical barometers across discrete geographic sites per fake identity. However, localized wind gusts can disrupt pressure correlations, occasionally triggering false rejections.
